about: Round 69, review of authz-agent PR #147: ${resourceType} in the rsql and mongodb predicates of a simplified policy whose resourceType differs from the request's type in letter case. Controls first and last answer true.

cases.about: Control: a simplified READ policy for the reader without a predicate; check/resource true, check/filter ALLOW.

Policy resourceType in upper case, request type in lower case. rsqlPredicate t==${resourceType} and predicates.mongodbPredicate { "t": "${resourceType}" }; check/resource true says the policy matched, and the filter texts show whose spelling the substitution carries: the request's or the policy's resourceType.

Policy resourceType in upper case, request type in mixed case. rsqlPredicate t==${resourceType} and predicates.mongodbPredicate { "t": "${resourceType}" }; check/resource true says the policy matched, and the filter texts show whose spelling the substitution carries: the request's or the policy's resourceType.

Policy resourceType in lower case, request type in upper case. rsqlPredicate t==${resourceType} and predicates.mongodbPredicate { "t": "${resourceType}" }; check/resource true says the policy matched, and the filter texts show whose spelling the substitution carries: the request's or the policy's resourceType.
Control: a simplified READ policy for the reader without a predicate; check/resource true, check/filter ALLOW.
